headline.en: US private credit default rate falls to 2.41% in Q3 2026, Proskauer index shows
headline.zh: Proskauer指数显示，美国私募信贷违约率在2026年第三季度降至2.41%

summary.en: Proskauer's Private Credit Default Index recorded a US default rate of 2.41 per cent in the third quarter of 2026, down from 2.51 per cent in the prior three months and the second consecutive quarterly decline. The index covered 746 senior-secured and unitranche loans representing $205.7bn in original principal amount. Proskauer warned trailing 12-month defaults rose and defaults among software and technology borrowers increased, with small-borrower defaults up from 1.9 per cent to 2.2 per cent.
summary.zh: Proskauer的私募信贷违约指数显示，2026年第三季度美国违约率为2.41%，低于前三个月的2.51%，为连续第二个季度下降。该指数覆盖746笔优先担保和unitranche贷款，原始本金总额为2057亿美元。Proskauer警告称，过去12个月违约率上升，软件和科技借款人的违约增加，小借款人违约率从1.9%升至2.2%。

headline.en: Corpay report: non-bank NAV lending margins widen to 794bp as bank margins narrow
headline.zh: Corpay报告：非银NAV贷款利差扩大至794个基点，银行利差收窄

summary.en: Corpay Private Markets' fifth Lender Book Report found average non-bank NAV lending margins widened from 756 basis points in February 2025 to 794 basis points in August 2026, while average bank NAV margins narrowed from 447 to 435 basis points. Alternative credit providers account for around 30 per cent of lenders tracked on Corpay's Alpha Match platform, up from roughly 25 per cent three years ago. Corpay said its data is weighted toward mid-market and complex NAV facilities and does not necessarily indicate rising non-bank NAV pricing across the whole market.
summary.zh: Corpay Private Markets第五份《Lender Book Report》显示，非银NAV贷款平均利差从2025年2月的756个基点扩大至2026年8月的794个基点，而银行NAV平均利差同期从447个基点收窄至435个基点。在Corpay Alpha Match平台追踪的贷款机构中，另类信贷机构占比约30%，三年前约为25%。Corpay表示其数据偏向中型及复杂的NAV融资，未必意味着整个市场的非银NAV定价上升。

items.source_headline: Non-bank NAV lending margins widen despite fund finance pricing pressure

reason.zh: 已评估严重程度：有限；关联程度：行业。

items.relevance_reason: NAV facility pricing trends shape credit deployment and returns for private credit managers, a tracked sub-sector.
